title: Aggregation dynamics of nanoplastics: insights through real world waste
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,384-391
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00760G, Paper
Ananda Pokhrel, Mohammad Saiful Islam, Somenath Mitra
Real-world PET and PS nanoplastics show electrolyte-dependent aggregation, and are stable in freshwater but rapidly coagulate in seawater, influencing their transport, bioavailability, and environmental risks.
